method: Headlines and the feeds' own summaries from SVT Nyheter, Sveriges Radio Ekot and the Government Offices, collected every few hours; each links to the article, which stays with its publisher. Items are tagged with the parties they name, the way newsrooms write them ('(S)', 'SD:s', 'Vänsterpartiet'), and topics by keyword; an item can name a party without being about it.
